1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de tronco grueso y recto, con follaje espeso de color castaño rojizo, hojas finas y redondas, y flores pequeñas amarillas verdosas; su madera se usa en carpintería. Melastomataceae, Mouriri domingensis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree with a thick and straight trunk, having dense foliage of reddish-brown color, fine and rounded leaves, and small yellow-green flowers; its wood is used in carpentry. Melastomataceae, Mouriri domingensis.

2.consolidated_definition: Fruto del caimitillo, baya de color morado con cinco semillas puntiagudas; es comestible.
2.en_consolidated_definition: Fruit of the caimitillo tree, purple berry with five pointed seeds; it is edible.
